entries.description: Spec-finalization cross-provider consensus, first route (task_type=analysis). Routed to gemini-pro. Returned a structured JSON recommendation on all 4 open spec decisions.
Verifier on the first consensus call (auto-verify task_type=analysis). Routed to gpt-5-4-mini.
Spec-finalization cross-provider consensus, second route (task_type=architecture). Pinned to opus per config. Returned a structured JSON recommendation triangulating Gemini's answer.
Verifier on the second consensus call (auto-verify task_type=architecture), first round. Routed to gpt-5-4.
Verifier retry on the second consensus call. Routed to gpt-5-4.
Routed analysis authored ai-assignment.md for the 3-session plan against the finalized spec. Routed to gemini-pro.

Cross-provider session-verification R1 against the initial implementation pass. Routed to gpt-5-4. Returned ISSUES_FOUND with four must-fix items (broaden resolver beyond SELECT, IsNull flag for null-key collision, ordinal-sort emitted dictionaries, positional OLE DB binding). All four addressed in-session.

Cross-provider session-verification R2 after R1 remediations. Routed to gpt-5-4. Returned ISSUES_FOUND with two must-fix items (add ReportBaselineService orchestrator over IReportQueryExecutor seam; switch group bucket identity from formatted-string to typed-value via TypedValueComparer). Both addressed in-session; inherited HomeHealthCare.accdb working-tree drift also reverted per nice-to-have.

Cross-provider session-verification R3 after R2 remediations. Routed to gpt-5-4. Returned ISSUES_FOUND with two must-fix items (canonicalize numeric GroupBucket.Key so 1m/1.00m/1.0m emit identical Key regardless of row order; sort Skipped at end of Compute so multi-overflow scenarios serialize identically across row permutations). Both addressed in-session.

Cross-provider session-verification R4 after R3 remediations. Routed to gpt-5-4. Returned VERIFIED with empty must_fix; three minor nice-to-haves filed for S2/S3 (ParametersUsed mutation regression test, opportunistic XML-doc nits, future bundled positional+provenance parameter shape).

S2 implementation pass: new ReportBaseline seams (IReportSource, IReportPdfRenderer, ReportLiveSpec, BaselineManifest{,Entry}, BaselineManifestWriter, ReportBaselineRunner), Windows-only COM impls (AccessReportSpecReader, AccessReportPdfRenderer), CLI subcommand (ReportBaselineCommand) + Program.cs dispatch/usage/exit-codes, hermetic tests (Runner 9, Writer 4, ParametersUsed mutation regression 1), [SkippableFact] integration test against HomeHealthCare.accdb (gated by Collection HomeHealthCareCom). No routed calls; orchestrator-direct mechanical wiring per Delegation Discipline (orchestrator matches default tier for this task type).

Solution build (0 errors). Targeted test run on AccessHarvester.Tests: 514 passed, 2 skipped (COM-required), 0 failed (was 499 in S1; +15 new tests). Full-solution test run after Cli usage-text fix: 9 projects green; AccessHarvester.Integration: 55 passed / 1 failed. The single Integration failure (SanitizeCommandTests.HomeHealthCare_sanitize) times out at the 120-second test budget even in true isolation — pre-existing, unrelated to S2 (manual sanitize CLI invocation against the same fixture also took 4+ minutes; not a parallelism issue). My S2 work fixed a CliUsageTextTests heading-string assertion (added "report-baseline" to the exit-code-heading + subcommand list per drift-gate semantics) and applied the existing [Collection] convention to 5 pre-existing parallel-COM-CLI Integration test classes (knocked failures 3->1). Reverted samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb + samples/MiniComplex.accdb Access-COM-side-effect drift before staging. No routed calls; mechanical orchestrator-direct work.

Cross-provider session-verification R1. Routed task_type=session-verification to gpt-5-4. Returned ISSUES_FOUND with two Major items: (1) positional-parameter binding relied on Dictionary enumeration order (unsound contract for the documented --params shape); (2) no stale-output cleanup on rerun. Plus coverage gap (no both-fail test) and two minor doc nits (Reason XML, PrintUsage wording).

Addressed R1 must-fixes in-session: (a) IReadOnlyList<KeyValuePair<string,object?>> replaces the per-report parameter Dictionary in IReportSource / Runner / CLI parameter contract; positional binding is now the list-index, not dictionary-enumeration-order; name-keyed provenance is derived from the list. (b) ReportBaselineRunner.Run gets cleanRoot:true default + --no-clean CLI opt-out (mirrors extract/run/translate); per-report dir is unconditionally recreated each capture. (c) Added Run_WithBothRenderAndAggregateFailure + Run_DefaultClean_RemovesStaleArtifacts + Run_NoCleanRoot_PreservesUnprocessedReports hermetic tests (+3, total 517 passing). (d) BaselineManifestEntry.Reason XML mentions ReadSpecFailed; PrintUsage updated. Reroute to gpt-5-4 task_type=session-verification: VERIFIED with empty issues. R2 cost /usr/bin/bash.125, 78s.

Step 8 closeout: appended S2 section to change-log.md (orchestrator, verification verdict, routed cost, Closed/Created/Changed inventory, Test results, R1/R2 remediation matrix, Deferred items, Notes for S3 calibration, next-orchestrator recommendation = gemini-pro @ medium); updated ai-assignment.md S2 Actuals; rewrote disposition.json (status=in-progress, S2 summary, files_changed[], next_orchestrator=gemini-pro/google/medium for S3); reverted samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb COM-side-effect drift before staging; staged 29 files (+2167/-36) covering S2 implementation + tests + Integration drift-gate fix + Collection serialization + session-set ledger updates; committed as 75faf77. Skipped from this commit: pre-existing .claude/scheduled_tasks.lock deletion (local-only, unrelated to S2) and untracked docs/session-sets/harvester-consumer-workflow-instructions/ DRAFT (pre-existing sibling consumer set).

Step 8 closeout: appended S2 section to change-log.md; updated ai-assignment.md S2 Actuals; rewrote disposition.json (status=in-progress, S2 summary, next_orchestrator=gemini-pro/google/medium for S3); reverted samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb COM-side-effect drift; staged 29 files (+2167/-36); committed as 75faf77.

Recovered Session 3 after a bad prior closeout attempt: report-baseline stays aggregates-first, --include-pdf is opt-in, aggregate failure now suppresses the render path, CLI/report-source lifetime handling was tightened to avoid COM/OLEDB lock contention in the validated scenario, the forged review artifact was removed, and docs/help text were updated to match the shipped behavior.

Validated the repaired slice with dotnet build AccessHarvester.sln (success), focused runner tests (13 passed), the usage-text test slice (pass), and a live report-baseline integration run against samples/HomeHealthCare.accdb showing two Captured reports (srptClientBudgets, srptClientCurrentNeeds) and two AggregateFailed reports (srptServicePlanEntries, srptServiceShortfall: No value given for one or more required parameters).

Cross-provider session-verification round 1 via gpt-5-4. Verdict: VERIFIED. Prompt included the Session 3 spec excerpt, the deferred follow-up set stub, the current diff for the repaired code/docs/tests slice, and the validated build/test/live-run results.

Cross-provider session-verification round 2 via forced gemini-pro query for the OpenAI-orchestrated session. Verdict: VERIFIED. This bypassed the session-verification routing override that is calibrated for Claude orchestrators.
